create_lof_outlier_detector: create a LocalOutlierFactor model to detect outliers in unsupervised datasets
fit_lof_on_training_data: fit the LocalOutlierFactor detector on training data to compute local outlier factors
predict_new_outliers: predict outlier labels for new unseen data using a fitted LocalOutlierFactor model
score_samples_anomalies: score new samples with LocalOutlierFactor to compute opposite LOF scores for anomaly detection
run_lof_fit_predict: run LocalOutlierFactor fit_predict to detect outliers and return binary labels in one step
